wiki_acceptance: A gated test asserts a drafted arrow reduces enemy HP to death.
assert_steps: Step 2 — ArrowProjectile count rises (arrow fired toward enemy in ranged window 1.2–5.0 units)
Step 3 — bandit.Hp drops below pre-damage level after arrow hit

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: ResearchManager.Instance may be null in the headless test scene. The test bootstraps one when absent. QA should verify that a real Game.unity scene test would pass without this bootstrap.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Test adds AddComponent<ResearchManager> to a fresh GameObject when Instance is null.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: PawnUtilityAI.arrowSprite is [SerializeField] private. The public SetArrowSprite() accessor exists and is used. No reflection needed.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Used SetArrowSprite() which is already public.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: BanditEnemy does not have [RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody2D))]. The test adds a Kinematic Rigidbody2D manually so ArrowProjectile.OnTriggerEnter2D fires on physics overlap. Without it the arrow may pass through the bandit collider without triggering.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Test manually adds Rigidbody2D (gravityScale=0, Kinematic) + BoxCollider2D (isTrigger=false) to the test BanditEnemy. QA should confirm physics collision fires in the test scene.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: BanditEnemy.maxHp is [SerializeField] private (default 20). Arrow damage is 4 per hit; killing from full HP requires 5 hits × 1.5s interval = 7.5s minimum. The test pre-damages the bandit to 4 HP so a single arrow finishes it within 2.5s. This relies on TakeDamage(16, null) being callable from test code — it is public.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Pre-damage via bandit.TakeDamage(initialHp - 4, null) leaves Hp=4; one arrow hit (damage=4) achieves the kill. Full 5-hit chain is exercised if QA wants to extend the wait window to 12s and remove pre-damage.
